# Issue #30 Context

## Summary
Improve CMake consumption: FetchContent, namespaced target, install/export support.

## AC Checklist
- [ ] `FetchContent_MakeAvailable(TiffCraft)` followed by `target_link_libraries(my_app PRIVATE TiffCraft::TiffCraft)` compiles and links.
- [ ] `cmake --install` produces a usable `TiffCraftConfig.cmake` and headers, and `find_package(TiffCraft)` exposes `TiffCraft::TiffCraft`.
- [ ] Building TiffCraft standalone still builds tests, apps, and examples by default.
- [ ] Consuming TiffCraft as a subdirectory does not build tests, apps, or examples.
- [ ] The README lists the FetchContent and `find_package` consumption steps.

## Primary Files and Rationale
- /home/daniel/tiffcraft/CMakeLists.txt — root cause: plain `TiffCraft` INTERFACE target, no alias, no install/export, unconditional subdirs.
- /home/daniel/tiffcraft/include/tiffcraft/*.hpp — public headers, namespace TiffCraft, include style `<tiffcraft/...>`.
- /home/daniel/tiffcraft/tests/CMakeLists.txt, apps/, examples/ — consumers of the un-namespaced target.
- /home/daniel/tiffcraft/README.md, CHANGELOG.md — docs to update.

## Change Approach
- Add `add_library(TiffCraft::TiffCraft ALIAS TiffCraft)`.
- Add `TIFFCRAFT_BUILD_ALL` option defaulting ON standalone / OFF when `CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR`.
- Guard `enable_testing()`/`add_subdirectory(tests|apps|examples)` behind the option.
- Add install/export: `install(TARGETS TiffCraft EXPORT TiffCraftTargets ...)`, `install(EXPORT TiffCraftTargets FILE TiffCraftTargets.cmake NAMESPACE TiffCraft:: DESTINATION ...)`, `write_basic_package_version_file` from `PROJECT_VERSION`, plus a generated `TiffCraftConfig.cmake`.
- Interface include dirs via `$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>` / `$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>`.
- Document FetchContent and find_package usage in README.

## Risks
- Version mismatch: project VERSION 0.1.0 vs header constants 0.2.0 (out of scope: release/version planning intentionally deferred).
- Guarding tests via option must not break standalone default (must build tests/apps/examples by default).
- Existing build/release artifacts may need re-configuration.

## Docs Impact
INLINE — README.md needs a new CMake consumption section; CHANGELOG.md needs an entry under [0.2.0-Unreleased] / Added.

Requirements: GATE A context file must exist and be complete. Write only this file; do not modify the repository.
